objective: Preallocate UPDATE schema lookup keys from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate UPDATE schema keys
tasks.result: UPDATE schema lookup now uses an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for schema:<table> keys.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for schema:<table> before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in UPDATE schema lookup key construction.
Generated schema key bytes, schema loads, update planning, index maintenance, row-cache invalidation, and SQL DML results are unchanged.
